title: directjump-dt
author: Robbie
description: Direct Jump and Start on Bar for the Digitakt mk1 (the Digitone version's port). SETTINGS > DIRECT JUMP, ticked: a pattern picked while the sequencer plays takes over on the next step, legato, from the same place in the bar (per-track scale mode included, all 16 tracks). SETTINGS > START ON BAR, ticked: with DIRECT JUMP unticked a pick starts its pattern from the first step on the next bar line of the Digitakt's song position, so it never loses a beat; and pressing the playing pattern's key relaunches it from its first step on the next beat, as a Perkons does. DIGISNAKE-DT 0.3 relaunches its paths with a start. Unticked, the stock behaviour. Chains play on as stock and song mode is left alone. The Digitakt's core keeps no project data: both settings are ticked at power-on. For OS 1.54; needs core (the Digitakt mk1's).
